status: Authorized staged execution; first run only until measured feasibility is reviewed.
question: How do two frozen complete pipelines differ in reported calls, losses, shared-policy validation evidence, runtime, and cost on public wastewater sequencing runs?
comparison: Previously implemented protein-alignment variant with its expanded upstream screen; same production downstream validation policy
reference: Reuse the retained October 2026 source genome/reference snapshot in both arms; no claim to reproduce the 20250825 simulated benchmark.
changes_not_in_scope: Additional NR agreement or both-mate species requirements
unchanged_downstream: Same production duplicate handling, hash-based validation sampling, query preparation, validation settings, taxonomy data, per-read statuses, and reporting code. Different aligner representations and score selection remain intrinsic differences.
validation: Original default nucleotide validation in both arms, maximum 20 per species per group. No NR.
grouping: Each selected sequencing run is a separate downstream group. Depths are separate executions, never pooled.
source_runtime: Reuse verified retained executable/reference environment, but execute a new frozen driver and archive source commit and commands.
sampling: Uniform pairs across each complete run, not first reads. 5M nested in 25M where selected.
execution_gate: Complete first paired comparison and verify baseline/output integrity before expansion. Initial batch is 10 runs including two deeper cases.
pinned_invariants: Original sequence and quality bytes preserved by subset selection
Both mates selected together with exact requested counts
Existing adapter parity fixtures remain unchanged
Same downstream parameters for both arms
